wire_ops.value: List issues, optionally filtered by status and assignee. Use to browse or enumerate issues by those filters; use search_issues to find issues by text in the title or body. Returns up to limit issues (50 by default). Comments are included by default; set include_comments to false for smaller responses.

Search issues by case-insensitive text match against title and body. Use when you have keywords; use list_issues to filter by status or assignee. No result limit and no status or assignee filters. Comments are included by default; set include_comments to false for smaller responses.

wire_ops.value: Lists issues, optionally filtered by status and assignee. Use to browse issues by those attributes; use search_issues to find issues by text in the title or body. Returns at most `limit` issues (default 50). Comments are included by default.

Searches issues by case-insensitive text match against title and body. Use when you have keywords; use list_issues to filter by status or assignee. Has no status, assignee or limit filters. Comments are included by default.
Filter by issue status. One of: open, in_progress, blocked, closed. Any other value returns an error. Omit to include all statuses.
Whether each returned issue includes its comments. Defaults to true; set false to return smaller summaries without comments.
